title: Phase 2: Add reliable and constrained computer execution
description:
Outcome: a turn can summon and use the household computer without duplicate actors, silent loss, indefinite billing, or authority granted by untrusted page content.

Scope: durable turn ownership, failure recovery, cold-computer readiness, mid-turn escalation, and browser authority controls.

Not included: the complete web experience, Kanbus product integration, routines, or billing.

Complete when every milestone in this initiative passes executable failure and security scenarios without an always-on control-plane component.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Derived from docs/ROADMAP.md immediate build order steps 3 through 6. Ownership and browser containment are release gates, not optional hardening after computer use ships.

comments.author: agent@example.com
comments.text: Status aligned with current work: computer summon/continuation, ThinTurn ECS host-start, and browser-authority epics are already in flight. Initiative is in_progress (not waiting on Phase 1 to close).
